sceneTasks.title: Rules
sceneTasks.hint: When the camera sees it, run an automation or say a line
sceneTasks.emptyHint: e.g. someone reading in bed → light on; gone for a minute → light off
sceneTasks.drawerHint: Runs as soon as the camera sees it — no assistant needed
sceneTasks.namePlaceholder: e.g. Reading in bed turns on the light
sceneTasks.camerasHint: Any one camera seeing it counts
sceneTasks.noCameras: No cameras yet — connect one in Xiaomi Home
sceneTasks.conditionPlaceholder: e.g. someone is reading in bed
sceneTasks.conditionHint: Describe something happening. Avoid “detected…” — it causes constant false triggers.
sceneTasks.sceneNotesPlaceholder: When it counts, e.g. only the right side of the bed; shadows and cables don't.
sceneTasks.sceneNotesHint: Applies to this rule only. For things that apply everywhere, use Settings → Global notes.
sceneTasks.enterHint: Runs once the condition has held for the enter-confirm time; longer = fewer false triggers.
sceneTasks.exitHint: Runs once the condition has been false for the exit-confirm time.
sceneTasks.dwellHint: After entering, exits automatically and runs the exit action. e.g. light on, off after 1 minute.
sceneTasks.confirmDelete: Delete “{{name}}”? Its rule is removed too. This can't be undone.
sceneTasks.triggerHint: Run the enter action once (for testing)
sceneTasks.triggerFail: Couldn't run it — check backend logs
sceneTasks.errQuery: Fill in what to watch for
sceneTasks.errScene: Set at least one action on enter or exit
sceneTasks.enterTtsHint: Works alongside the Mi Home scene above.
sceneTasks.exitTtsHint: Speaks once the condition ends; also on auto-exit.
sceneTasks.noSpeakers: No speakers in Xiaomi Home — bind and connect one in the Mi Home app first.
sceneTasks.ttsPromptPlaceholder: e.g. Look at my outfit and praise it in one playful sentence, mentioning the colors.
sceneTasks.ttsTextPlaceholder: e.g. Have a great day — see you soon.
sceneTasks.ttsFallbackPlaceholder: Spoken if nothing was written on the spot. Leave empty to stay quiet (the automation still runs).
sceneTasks.dynamicTtsUnavailable: “Written on the spot” needs the perception engine running in scene-only mode. Until then the backup line (if any) is spoken.
sceneTasks.errTtsPrompt: {{side}}: write what to say, or a backup line
